answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by locking stakes in tiered geological vaults: entry-level agents stake basalt bonds for baseline compute, upgraded identities lock marble deposits for high-volume transactions, and governance routers require an onyx tier security bond. If an identity misbehaves or coordinates duplicate swarm voting, all bonded collateral is instantly slashed. Attacker cost scales superlinearly: maintaining thousands of fake agents forces the adversary to lock and forfeit massive capital in marble and onyx vaults across every epoch.
